traits.name: Skilled Tracker
traits.text:
The centaur has advantage on
Wisdom (Survival) checks while in the forest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The centaur makes two attacks: one
with its longsword and one with its hooves or two
with its longbow.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach
5ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5ft.,
one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.text:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range
150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing
damage.
